correctness.rationale: All squarefree four-prime cases exhaust the odd/even support split. Odd n and even minimum odd prime at least 11 are deficient; a=7 has only 2002, excluded by a 28 deficit smaller than any pair. For a=5, abundance forces b=7,11,13,17; for a=3, a necessary omitted large pair yields (b-12)(c-12)<=150 and b=5,7,11,13,17,19. All ten remaining fixed cores have exactly 8 pairs, and the exact affine equation is enumerated for all 256 subsets each without zero-denominator exceptions. The extracted verifier also checks uniqueness and a separate direct census to 5000. Finite enumeration is complete only because every unbounded parameter is proved to belong to one of ten affine cores.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the first squarefree Omega=4 multiplicity stratum immediately beyond the existing Omega<=3 obstruction. The exactly seven numbers, each with a unique complementary divisor representation, are unexpectedly finite despite many strongly pseudoperfect constructions being infinite; the prime-support reduction proves no larger examples, rather than reporting a bounded census.
